summary.text: Daphne Campbell is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 108 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Wancito Francius in a race with no incumbent.
A registered nurse, she previously served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2010 to 2016 and in the Florida State Senate, District 38, from 2016 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Daphne Campbell received a B.A. from SOD Nursing School in 1981, and her professional experience includes working as a registered nurse.
Ballotpedia lists her religion as Seventh-Day Adventist.
Campbell represented Florida House District 108 from 2010 to 2016.
In 2016 she won the general election for Florida State Senate District 38, receiving 75.24% of the vote, and assumed office on November 8, 2016.

She served on the Senate's Children, Families, and Elder Affairs; Communications, Energy, and Public Utilities; Community Affairs; and Joint Administrative Procedures committees at the start of the 2017 session.
Jason Pizzo defeated her in the August 28, 2018 Democratic primary for Senate District 38, 54.1% to 45.9%, and she left office on November 6, 2018.
She ran in the 2020 Democratic primary for State Senate District 35, finishing second to Shevrin Jones with 15.6% of the vote.
In 2026 Campbell won the Democratic primary for House District 108 with 46.1% of the vote (6,640 votes), defeating Dinah Escarment and Peter Walsh.
